title: Signed public hostname and managed edge routing provisioning
intended_behavior: The deployment wizard offers a distinct public-route step for an operator-selected fully qualified hostname, target port, and HTTPS health path.
Bahia validates managed-zone ownership, protected-zone policy, provider collisions, signed runtime port exposure, upstream HTTP, and managed edge TLS before intent creation.
The authoritative preview contains exact non-secret DNS, remote-tunnel, proxy, TLS, apply-order, rollback, and provider-configuration hash data inside the desired-state hash.
A healthy application is applied before remote Cloudflare Tunnel ingress and proxied DNS; HTTPS verification completes the run.
Provider mutations compensate on failure, and a route failure restores the previous application desired state when one exists.
